# Portal 2 Steam2 XSI source reference

This directory preserves the source and project files under
`portal2/sdktools/XSI/5.0/ValveSourceCodeDrop` in Steam2 depot `841`,
version `1`, blob CRC `8f160ceb`. The files were extracted from the
`83ced978` version-0 to `8f160ceb` version-1 depot chain. The 392 files
include 41 C++ implementations, headers, XSI plugin scripts, and Visual
Studio projects. Prebuilt DLLs, binaries, and media were omitted.
The aggregate SHA-256 over sorted relative paths, NUL separators, and the
raw SHA-256 digest of each imported file is
`0d4af8c8d8a7e0eb7f1229150a5f79ae8525ea92a4a96fcdcfb8453449fad9cf`.

This is historical XSI SMD and VMF tool source. It does not provide missing
Portal 2 client or server gameplay implementations and is not selected by
Waf. The original `EULA.txt` is preserved here. Its use and redistribution
conditions require review before packaging or publishing this material.

Source metadata: [Steam2 depot 841 manifest](https://femtendo.github.io/steam2-catalog/#depot-841).
